key_insight: TongGeometry combines neural guidance with symbolic tree search to both propose and solve olympiad-level geometry problems, discovering hard yet concise problems automatically.
problem_solved: Automates the discovery and solution of challenging geometry problems that traditionally require expert human creativity and lengthy manual proof search, enabling scalable generation of high-quality math problems and proofs.
method: Neural-guided tree search: learn policy/value models to prioritize construction and proof branches during symbolic search.
Difficulty-conciseness scoring and pruning: rank candidate problems to find problems that are both hard and succinct while keeping search tractable.
Formal verification and synthesis: generate, synthesize and verify geometric proofs to ensure correctness of proposed and solved problems.
impact: Advances neural-symbolic mathematical reasoning and enables automated benchmark/problem generation for research and education, lowering the barrier to studying advanced geometry with verifiable solutions.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: propose → guided tree search → verify (icons for neural model, search tree, proof checker).
Search tree visualization: highlighted paths showing neural-guided branch selection vs unguided search.
Example olympiad problem: geometry figure with solution steps annotated to show concise proof found by the system.
Scatter plot: difficulty vs conciseness of generated problems, illustrating selection of hard-but-short instances.
paper_title: Proposing and solving olympiad geometry with guided tree search
paper_authors: Chi Zhang, Jiajun Song, Siyu Li, Yitao Liang, Yuxi Ma
